releases.notes:
Main update bringing compatability for Minecraft 1.21.2-1.21.11 on Fabric and Neoforge. Also fixes a couple issues with lang and translation in the datapacks.

The main change here is replicating java functionality of getting resources on Neoforge 1.21.9+ because they break it for some reason??? I can't quite tell what's going on there but I Think:tm: it's a bug with them, so I found a workaround. it's. Something, thats for sure.

Either way, have fun!!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/gamma-02/moss-fix-remastered/compare/2.0.0...2.1.0

releases.notes:
Needless to say, I have completely rewrote this mod for the third time, hence how this is release 2.0.0.

The mod has been rewritten for maximum compatibility across different mods, versions, and platforms (except Forge after NeoForge was created). Currently, we only have official support up to 1.21.1, though you can find planned support on this [version tracking document](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1B4C_D2asPomPq7kbOQNiG-LJorGvj14SLeHua14sHN4/edit?usp=sharing)

Please report issues here!

This was a labor of love for one of my earlier, but still most popular, mods.

Have fun!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/gamma-02/moss-fix-remastered/commits/2.0.0
